audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Ziggs / Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs / Skill / Ziggs while the page's own prose says the opposite in four places: whys[1] calls level 2 a coin-flip, whys[2] gives level 3 to Riven, whys[5] says her first-item ult spike restores kill pressure, whys[6] says a fed Riven deletes you. packet.levelChart reads Ziggs / Skill / Riven / Ziggs / Ziggs / Riven / Riven, and the mirror (riven__ziggs) settled Level 3 as Skill, Levels 4-5 as Ziggs and Level 6 as Riven.
audit.why: This is the worst chart-versus-prose split in the slice — six of seven rows disagreed with something. Level 3 is genuinely Skill rather than hers: Broken Wings is 13s for the whole chain, Ki Burst 11s and Valor 10s, so between attempts she has nothing. From Level 6 the ult adds damage, attack range and a Wind Slash, and that lead only grows with items.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill, row 3 to Ziggs, rows 4, 5 and 6 to Riven — matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs in one atomic group with all six ratings moved. Rows 2, 3 and 4 follow the mirror's ratings inverted (5/10, 7/10, 4/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says 'You even out at 6' and phases[4].why claims Level 6 as your Mega Inferno Bomb spike. Level 6 is hers.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s and grants bonus attack damage AND bonus attack range, plus one Wind Slash per cast — a ranged finisher on a champion who otherwise cannot touch you at 850. Your ult is 120s and does not win a duel.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and phases[4].why restated as her spike with the 120s timer; phases[5].why and phases[6].why restated to the item and late rows now belonging to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects says it outright: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere. Ki Burst, Broken Wings and Valor are named repeatedly with no timers, and dosFull[2].d invents a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Ki Burst is 11/10/9/8/7s, Broken Wings a flat 13s for all three casts, Valor 10/9/8/7/6s with a damage block, against your Satchel Charge at 20/18/16/14/12s. Those numbers are the whole lane: her tools return two to three times per Satchel, so 'bait the stun' only works if you also count the dashes.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns written into spikes[0].text, whys[2], phases[1].why, phases[2].why and dosFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wind Slash was never mentioned as a separate, once-per-ult ranged attack.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit that Wind Slash is usable once during Blade of the Exile. That is the only tool in her kit that reaches you at poke range, so it belongs on the level 6 row.
audit.corrected: Named in spikes[1].text, phases[4].why and whys[4].

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: W Satchel online at 20s — your only escape, and Broken Wings gets three casts to bait it out of you.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Riven can't read the angle.
edits.after: Full kit, but Broken Wings dashes three times through it — the minefield slows her, it never keeps her off you.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile online: bonus damage, bonus range and one Wind Slash — 120s, and her window, not yours.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Riven now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Her items land on top of the ult window, and Valor's shield eats your chip — so poke only once it is spent.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: A fed Riven flanks and kills you before your rotation lands — buy Zhonya's and ward wide, not more damage.

edits.before: Riven burns Ki Burst (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Riven burns Ki Burst (Stun) on nothing — that is an eleven-second invitation.

edits.before: Level 3 Riven's full combo with Valor shield lets her dash in and out-burst you.
edits.after: Level 3 her combo can reach you, but Ki Burst is 11s and Valor 10s between tries.

edits.before: By 4-5 your defensive buys and W peel pull the lane back to even-favoured.
edits.after: By 4-5 your defensive buys and W peel put the lane back in your favour.

edits.before: At 6 your Mega Inferno Bomb and hard shove let you deny her all-in window.
edits.after: At 6 Blade of the Exile adds damage, attack range and one Wind Slash.

edits.before: With her full Q chain, Valor (E) shield and Broken Wings mobility Riven can dash through your minefield and burst you; hold Satchel (W) to peel her off.
edits.after: Broken Wings is 13s for all three casts, Ki Burst 11s and Valor 10s with a damage block — she crosses your minefield and bursts, so hold Satchel (W) for the third dash.

edits.before: You even out at 6 — shove her under tower with Q and R and deny the all-in; keep W to displace her mid-combo when she jumps in.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 120s at rank 1: bonus damage, longer attack range and one Wind Slash. Shove and leave — this row is hers to duel.

notes: Chart proposed as six matched side/win pairs in one atomic group. Rows 2, 3 and 4 follow the mirror (its 5/10, 3/10, 6/10 inverted to 5/10, 7/10, 4/10); rows 1, 5 and 6 follow packet.levelChart plus this page's own whys, which the mirror did not cover. WARNING carried from the mirror: riven__ziggs reported that full-layer prose on disk contains mojibake em dashes, and it therefore restricted itself to enum fields there. I have proposed seven full-layer prose edits anyway, copied character-exact from the brief's currentText; if the brief and disk disagree those seven will be rejected as STALE and only the enum flips will land, which is a safe failure. Not asserted: whether Satchel Charge's knockback interrupts Broken Wings mid-dash, and whether Ki Burst's stun is reduced by tenacity.
